info.name: Hello World API - Test Suite
info.description:
Test suite for GET /hello-world. Each request is one scenario from docs/test-scenarios.md; the ID is the prefix of the request name.

Start the app (`mvn spring-boot:run`), then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Change the `baseUrl` collection variable if the app is not on http://localhost:8080.

Query values are already percent-encoded so they reach the server byte-for-byte.
